title: Sunshine in My Soul
alsoKnownAs: There Is Sunshine in My Soul Today
description: Sunshine in My Soul in Tonic Solfa to SUNSHINE: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the 4 verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Eliza E. Hewitt wrote the words, and John R. Sweney the tune SUNSHINE; both were first published in Glad Hallelujahs (Philadelphia, 1887), edited by William J. Kirkpatrick and Sweney.
underlay: There is sun-shine in my soul to-day, More_ glo-ri-ous and bright Than_ glows in an-y earth-ly sky, For Je-sus is my light. Oh, there’s sun-shine, bless_-ed sun-shine, When the peace-ful, hap-py mo-ments roll; When_ Je-sus shows His smil_-ing_ face, There is sun-shine in my soul.

lines: There is sunshine in my soul today,
More glorious and bright
Than glows in any earthly sky,
For Jesus is my light.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Oh, there’s sunshine, blessed sunshine,
When the peaceful, happy moments roll;
When Jesus shows His smiling face,
There is sunshine in my soul.
There is music in my soul today,
A carol to my King;
And Jesus, listening, can hear
The songs I cannot sing.
There is springtime in my soul today,
For, when the Lord is near,
The dove of peace sings in my heart,
The flow’rs of grace appear.
There is gladness in my soul today,
And hope and praise and love,
For blessings which He gives me now,
For joys laid up above.
